posts.text: Does Los Angeles County have a 112% registration rate? The question was asked because a lawsuit alleged that. But the truth is that Los Angeles County keeps active and inactive voters (who can’t vote) in  its voter rolls. This makes the total number of  registrations contained in the rolls larger than the voting population, but only because inactive voters may have passed or moved out of the county. posts.text: A federal court blocked a Trump order that would have transferred 14 transgender women from a women’s federal prison to a men’s facility.  The judge referenced the danger to these women in his decision.  The Trump administration order originates from Trump’s Executive Order 14168 requiring that all federal inmates be housed in a facility that matches their assigned gender at birth.
